build_vision_entry_layer: build a Flax VisionEntry module to patchify images and add factorized positional embeddings
build_vision_exit_layer: build a Flax VisionExit module to downsample vision embeddings via spatial pooling and scaling
build_standardize_layer: build a Flax Standardize module to apply feature-wise standardization with learnable scale and bias
review_visionentry_call: review the VisionEntry __call__ method to understand image patchification and positional embedding logic
review_visionexit_downsample: review the VisionExit _maybe_downsample method to understand position-based and grid-based pooling strategies
